definitions.explanation: A formal declaration or promise made publicly, especially in legal, political, or ceremonial contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{宣誓|せんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{証人|しょうにん}→証人：18845_shounin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法廷|ほうてい}→法廷：15113_houtei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{宣誓|せんせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The witness took an oath in court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{宣誓|せんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げ→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧、⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The representative athlete read the oath at the opening ceremony, and the tournament began.

notes:
{宣誓|せんせい} combines {宣|せん} (declare, announce) and {誓|せい} (swear, vow).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宣誓|せんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take an oath)
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{宣誓|せんせい} (athlete's oath — at sports events)
- {宣誓|せんせい}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (sworn statement, affidavit)
- {宣誓|せんせい}{式|しき} (swearing-in ceremony)
- ⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧{宣誓|せんせい} (inauguration oath)

CULTURAL NOTE:
At Japanese sports events, the ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧{宣誓|せんせい} is a tradition where a representative athlete pledges fair play on behalf of all participants. This is especially prominent at school athletic festivals and national high school tournaments.
